proceedings.deciding_body: Qualification and Disciplinary Commission (QDC) of the Regional Bar of Zakarpattya
proceedings.outcome: suspended the applicant’s licence to practise as an advocate for six months
proceedings.supporting_quote: On 17 April 2013, the QDC of Zakarpattya suspended the applicant’s licence to practise as an advocate for six months.

proceedings.deciding_body: Qualification and Disciplinary Commission (QDC) of the Regional Bar of Zakarpattya
proceedings.supporting_quote: This decision was upheld on 16 May 2013.

proceedings.deciding_body: Higher Qualification and Disciplinary Commission of the Bar (HQDCB)
proceedings.outcome: the draft was rejected because it did not receive a sufficient majority
proceedings.supporting_quote: In July 2016, a draft decision to grant the appeal and annul the suspension was put to a vote. However, due to changes in the Rules of Procedure adopted in 2014, the draft was rejected because it did not receive a sufficient majority.

proceedings.outcome: challenged the decisions of the Zakarpattya Bar and the HQDCB
proceedings.supporting_quote: On 5 October 2016, the applicant challenged the decisions of the Zakarpattya Bar and the HQDCB.

proceedings.outcome: decided not to examine the appeal
proceedings.supporting_quote: On 22 December 2016, the Podilskyy District Court decided not to examine the appeal.
The applicant appealed this to the Kyiv Administrative Court of Appeal, which quashed the Podilskyy court's decision on 6 March 2017.

proceedings.outcome: ruled that all decisions issued by the Bar's self-government bodies were lawful
proceedings.supporting_quote: On 8 April 2021, the court ruled that all decisions issued by the Bar's self-government bodies were lawful.

proceedings.outcome: rejected the appeals, finalizing the finding that the Bar's procedures had been lawful
proceedings.supporting_quote: On 9 December 2021, the Supreme Court rejected the appeals, finalizing the finding that the Bar's procedures had been lawful.
